# WWW2-9872: /wp-admin/, /techdocs/html/ and /rss2/ were Disallowed here, which
# blocked the crawl that would deindex them — so Google kept them as URL-only
# index entries indefinitely. They now return 410 Gone from proxy.ts
# (lib/proxy/gonePathGuard.ts) and must stay crawlable for that signal to land.
# Do not re-add Disallow lines for them.
#
# WWW2-9872 (follow-up): the /medialibrary/ and /product-compare/ trees now
# return 410 Gone from the same guard. Their Disallow lines are removed for the
# reason above, and the 223 per-PDF Allow lines under /medialibrary/ went with
# them — an Allow is meaningless once the whole tree answers 410. /en/us stays
# Disallowed: it is a live redirect source in bulk-redirects.csv, not a 410.
